title: Stationary Action on a Configuration
statement: Let $c$ be a configuration and $q$ a state. Applying the action that makes no input-head movement, makes no work-tape writes or head movements, emits no output symbol, and sets the successor state to $q$ yields $c$ with its state replaced by $q$.
